facts.text: The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment for joining, offered from Cedric's promissory note (975 gold pieces, payable once the caravans flow again).
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not say whether the note was handed over to the recruits at recruitment or whether payment is still owed.

facts.text: Cedric the storekeeper signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold pieces (three-quarters price for their treasure) once the caravans flow again; collection waits on supply shipments resuming.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi recommended using the note to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda, who then joined (beat_47); it may have been handed over.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or gave it to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda as payment.
